Police were yesterday continuing to investigate the death of Hui Wan-shan, 28, girlfriend of the former drummer with rock band Beyond, Yip Sai-wing. Her body was found by Yip, 39, in a water-filled bathtub at their Lai Man Court flat in Shau Kei Wan Road on Tuesday afternoon.

A post-mortem examination was inconclusive and further tests including a toxicology examination are needed, police said.
